staffAccess.title: Staff access
staffAccess.description: Which staff see and edit this catalogue's publications. OpenRegister enforces it through the rules OpenCatalogi writes on the schemas the catalogue covers. Only an administrator may change it.

restricted.title: Restricted
restricted.description: Only the groups below see and edit this catalogue's publications.

readGroups.title: Who can see unpublished publications
readGroups.description: The groups whose members see this catalogue's unpublished publications. Used only when access is restricted.

editGroups.title: Who can edit
editGroups.description: The groups whose members see, create, edit and delete this catalogue's publications. Used only when access is restricted.
